title: Open Values Errand Registry v0.1
description: A list of everyday tasks, such as the weekly grocery shop, each broken into the categories a person picks from to do it. Conscious Consuming keeps it.

format.description: Always "ovs-errand-registry". Tells a reader that this file is the list of errands.

version.description: The version of the errand registry format this file follows, 0.1.

updated.description: The day the file was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

errands.description: The errands. An errand is a real task, such as the weekly grocery shop, broken into the categories a person picks from to do it.

id.description: The errand's id, written "ovs:errand/" then a short name, such as "ovs:errand/weekly-groceries".

label.description: The errand's name as shown to people, such as "Weekly groceries".

aliases.description: Other words people use for the errand, such as "weekly shop". Search matches them.

reads.description: One sentence saying what the errand is for.

output.description: Always "list": the errand produces a list of picks.

tradeoff.description: Two criterion keys naming the trade-off the errand is about, such as "economical" and "nutrition_grade". The build checks that every step's category scores on both.

steps.description: The categories to pick from, in order.

cat.description: The id of the category (facts file) to pick from, such as "bread".

pick.description: Whether to pick "one" option from the category or "several".

note.description: One sentence saying why this step is in the errand.
